name: rolling-component-messages
cmd: set -euo pipefail; temp=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$temp"' EXIT; printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$temp/package.json"; (cd "$temp" && bun add --dev @commitlint/cli @commitlint/config-conventional >/dev/null); printf "module.exports={extends:['@commitlint/config-conventional']};\n" > "$temp/commitlint.config.cjs"; for file in message-input/*.txt; do sha256sum "$file"; "$temp/node_modules/.bin/commitlint" --cwd "$temp" < "$file"; done
